stemMd: Which change in the narrator is central to "The garden ledger"?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The narrator learns that all plant labels are deliberately false.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The narrator decides to replace the coordinator.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The narrator becomes opposed to keeping accurate records.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The narrator develops an interest in the garden beyond obtaining documented volunteer hours.

explanationMd: At first the narrator watches the clock for a certificate. Learning to recognize plants draws the narrator into the work so strongly that the signature is briefly forgotten.

distractorRationale.b: No desire to take Ben's position appears.
distractorRationale.c: The narrator still accepts Ben's signature; the change is in motivation.
distractorRationale.a: Only one outdated label is identified.
